answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the ivory of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
